paragraphs: Rav Malkhya: 'spit, maidservants and hair-follicles' belong to Rav Malkhiyu; 'forelock, burnt ash and cheese' to Rav Malkhya. Beitzah 28b; Ketubbot 61b; Makkot 21a; Avodah Zarah 29a; Niddah 52. R. Adda bar Ahavah said, Makkot there; Avodah Zarah 35b. He visited R. Simlai's house, Shabbat 46a.
